name: Canvas LMS
description: A base module holding two shared settings (institution name and environment) for the Instructure Canvas LMS integration modules.
project_description: This module is solely intended as a "parent" module for other modules in the Canvas LMS ecosystem. It creates a category on the Configuration page and provides two settings shared amongst those modules: the institution name (the subdomain of the *.instructure.com URL) and the desired Canvas instance environment (test, beta, or production). It ships no API client, no entities, no permissions and no plugins of its own. Related modules: Canvas API, Canvas LTI.
